acceptanceCriteria: Done means the package absent from `-unresolved` and its tests still passing.
body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/ideas.md (entry dated 2026-09-21).

`gate-affected-select -unresolved` lists `cmd/corvint` for `os.Getwd` in `dogfood_record.go`, so every tree change reruns it (most of the suite's wall time) under the GL-V0-004 tree key. Bounding that read moves it under Go's cache for same-worktree reruns. Done means the package absent from `-unresolved` and its tests still passing.

2026-10-01 AFP-V0-023 (PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/438, branch claude/ci-affected-selection at 8f7a8ba8 on origin/main 2aec8fec): the project-owned .corvint/test-read-scopes.json declares measured read scopes for 99 root-locating test packages (75 entries), so planner and selector select them through DECLARED_READ_SCOPE instead of the rule (d) floor; an invalid declaration fails closed to the full run. Full CI runs declared packages under the Landlock wrapper .github/testconfine (ABI>=2), so a too-narrow scope fails rather than under-selects. Replay of 16 recent merges: mean 200->166 packages selected (-17.1%), 5023->4543 package-seconds (-9.6%). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-01-declared-test-read-scopes.md; CEM .corvint/changes/6eec96cac12c30d6ccecbeec9659716d72e392c7.cem.json (52/52 supported, dogfood-check PASS, sealed); focused tests pass; one independent review, both should-fix findings fixed. NOT_RUN: hosted confined full CI run (needs admin ci-control-plane approval for .github at the exact head), make gate. cmd/corvint is not covered by this declaration (its os.Getwd read is unchanged), so this ticket is unaffected; recorded for context only.
title: cmd/corvint: bound the one `os.Getwd` so the largest package leaves the unresolved set
